scientific_integrity: The new result is a self-contained theorem with an elementary analytic proof and finite exact-arithmetic consistency checks; all source-based priority comparisons are qualified. No independent scientific validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The full, unrestricted finite-path maximal-variation conjecture is not proved.
The graph metric, counting measure, 1-variation and unimodality of the absolute value are essential hypotheses of the statement.
The peak-location coefficients are valid lower bounds, not separately claimed sharp.
Unindexed or differently phrased earlier work may overlap with the claimed new theorem.
title: Sharp finite-path variation for unimodal data and peak-location rigidity
